skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK Direct DMG to a single target. After casting the first Ultimate, can reduce the target's [Non-Critical Hit Invincibility].

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Reduces the target's [Non-Critical Hit Invincibility] by 1 round. Deals 7000% ATK Direct DMG to a single target (only affected by high-level DMG Reduction), negates 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Additionally gains +50% Crit Rate. Ultimate DMG 7000% > 10,000% ATK.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. After any character is defeated, gains 1 layer of [Explosion], up to 2 layers; each layer of [Explosion] adds 1 target to the Ultimate.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When near-death, enters [Resurrection], absorbing all DMG types; the next round recovers 50% HP and gains [Energy Resilience] equal to the amount absorbed, at most 3 times. At the start of the battle, gains 30% [Suppression DMG Reduction]. — [Suppression DMG Reduction]: Reduces DMG received by 30%; when ATK is higher than the attacker, reduces by 150%.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Gains [Suppression DMG Reduction] 30% > 40%. — [Suppression DMG Reduction]: Reduces DMG received 30% > 40%; when ATK is higher than the attacker, reduces by 150% > 170%.

effects.desc: Đòn chí mạng gây thêm sát thương; Some units may be immune to [Crit].
The revive/return mechanism is tied to the life of the ally, bringing the unit back into the match.
The shield type converts its cumulative value into damage reduction, is limited to a multiple of the unit's maximum Health, and cannot be used with Resurrection.
The defensive effect reduces damage taken (30–40%), increasing to a 150–170% reduction when the bearer's ST is higher than the attacker's.
